run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-17T04:05:23Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/checkout is backed by checkout's own failing spans: the server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder on service_name=checkout records STATUS_CODE_ERROR (rpc.grpc.status_code=13, otel.status_description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400'), rising from 0 at 04:05:23 to about 0.5 spans/s and still ~0.22/s at 04:44:23. The deepest failing point visible in the traces is shipping's POST /get-quote server span, which checkout's erroring 'HTTP POST' client span calls as its only child and which ends in 37-469 microseconds without ever calling the quote service, whereas the successful /get-quote spans take 17-36 ms and chain into POST quote -> POST /getquote -> calculate-quote. The rate gap shipping '/get-quote' minus 'POST quote' matches checkout's PlaceOrder error rate sample for sample, so the alert counts exactly the /get-quote requests shipping rejects (HTTP 400 per the caller's message) before requesting a quote. Why shipping rejects that ~26% subset is not observable in this Run: shipping writes no error line to stdout, tags neither error nor status on these spans, and request/response payloads are unavailable. The 'email service' wording in the error text is not supported by email's own telemetry (its observed POST /send_order_confirmation spans carry http.status_code 200 and no email error series exists), so it should not be read as email impact. No pod-level damage is visible (all otel-demo pods Running/Ready, 0 restarts, no Evicted/OOMKilled/Unhealthy events), no fault-injection flag in ConfigMap flagd-config is enabled, and the only in-window workload change is a load-generator ReplicaSet rollout at 04:29:29-30 that postdates the error onset and is rejected as the cause.

claims.text: Checkout's own error signal: traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} rate (5m) is 0 at 04:05:23, 0.0137/s at 04:06:23, 0.3259/s at 04:11:23, peaks near 0.516/s around 04:16-04:18, and is 0.2202/s at 04:44:23; the STATUS_CODE_UNSET series for the same span is about 1.5-3.0/s, and the 'HTTP POST' span carries identical error values.

Checkout's failing spans record status error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description/exception.message 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' (service checkout, service_version 2.1.3, operations oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and 'HTTP POST'); the 'HTTP POST' spans carry error=true with no additional error detail.

In trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231 the failing checkout 'HTTP POST' client span (duration 826 microseconds, error=true) has as its only child shipping's '/get-quote' span (span_id a170b05e15f5aeba, duration 469 microseconds, no status tag) and that span has no child call to the quote service; the same trace shows checkout PlaceOrder erroring with the shipping-quote message while frontend and load-generator spans carry http.status_code 500.

Successful checkout traces show the healthy /get-quote shape: shipping '/get-quote' 36.4 ms and 17.8 ms with child 'POST quote' -> quote 'POST /getquote' -> quote '{closure}' -> quote 'calculate-quote', email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' with http.status_code 200 (plus email send_email/sinatra.render_template), and cart, currency, product-catalog and payment spans all reporting rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (currency also otel.status_code=OK).

The rate difference shipping '/get-quote' minus shipping 'POST quote' (get-quote calls that never reached the quote service) tracks checkout's PlaceOrder error rate: 0.40372/s vs 0.40372/s at 04:22:23, 0.46296/s vs 0.46667/s at 04:30:23, 0.36667/s vs 0.36667/s at 04:32:23, and 0.22399/s vs 0.22020/s at 04:44:23; at 04:44:00 shipping rates were /get-quote 1.0037/s, POST quote 0.7382/s and /ship-order 0.7382/s.

The deepest failing span visible in these traces belongs to the shipping service: checkout's erroring 'HTTP POST' client span calls shipping '/get-quote' as its only child, and that /get-quote span ends abnormally fast with no downstream quote call, i.e. the observed rejection occurs at shipping's /get-quote entry point before the quote service is invoked.

The shipping workload looks healthy at pod/workload level: pod shipping-75d58f5d84-kgmz9 is Running, container 'shipping' ready with restartCount 0 and no waiting reason or lastState.terminated reason; its ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 is controlled by Deployment shipping (controller=true), and the Deployment runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping with 1/1 ready replicas.

Shipping's stdout for 04:09:30-04:09:40 contains only the lines 'Requesting quote', 'Sending Quote' and 'Tracking ID Created', with a gap between 04:09:35.724 and 04:09:39.188 - the interval covering the failing /get-quote call seen in trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231 - and a filtered read for error/invalid/fail/400/quote matched only those normal quote lines, no rejection output.

The checkout pod runs the unmodified demo image and configuration: container checkout image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080, EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080, CART_ADDR=cart:8080, PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, plus a wait-for-kafka init container; no fault-injection variable appears in its environment.

Every fault-style flag in ConfigMap flagd-config/otel-demo is at defaultVariant 'off' (paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, cartFailure, productCatalogFailure, emailMemoryLeak, adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, recommendationCacheFailure); only loadGeneratorFloodHomepage defaults to '100'.

The only workload change recorded for otel-demo inside the window is a load-generator rollout at 04:29:29-04:29:30: Deployment load-generator scaled new ReplicaSet load-generator-7d5756fbd9 from 0 to 1 and old load-generator-c7cbc4c99 from 1 to 0, with pod load-generator-7d5756fbd9-zzj4z Created/Started and pod load-generator-c7cbc4c99-xlnk2 Killing.

No pod-level damage is visible in otel-demo: all 21 pods are phase Running with ready containers, restartCount 0, no waiting reasons and no lastState.terminated reason, and the events returned for the namespace are only the load-generator rollout events (no Evicted, OOMKilled or Unhealthy entries).

Service wiring does not explain a refusal: Services checkout, shipping, email and quote are ClusterIP with selector opentelemetry.io/name=<service> and port 8080 -> targetPort 8080, and the NetworkPolicy query for the cluster returned an empty list of objects.

An all-service error-span rate query over 03:30-04:45 returned error series only for checkout ('HTTP POST', 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder'), frontend ('POST', 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder') and frontend-proxy ('ingress', 'router frontend egress'), plus ~0.0037/s on flagd 'EventStream' spans in ad, fraud-detection and recommendation and zero-valued series for accounting and payment operations; it contained no series for shipping, email, quote, cart, currency or product-catalog.

The ~26% of checkout PlaceOrder failures are caused by the shipping service rejecting a subset of POST /get-quote requests with HTTP 400 (the 'got 400' in checkout's error text) before it calls the quote service; because shipping tags neither an error status nor logs the rejection, the trigger is not visible and would need request/response capture at shipping's /get-quote handler.

Alternatively the rejected /get-quote requests could be malformed on the caller side (checkout building a payload shipping's handler refuses), so the defect could sit in checkout's request construction rather than in shipping's handler; the available telemetry cannot separate these, since no request bodies, no shipping status tags and no shipping rejection logs were obtainable.

The error text's reference to the email service is not supported by email's own telemetry: in the observed successful traces email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' spans carry http.status_code 200, the failing checkout 'HTTP POST' span's only child is shipping '/get-quote' rather than an email call, and the all-service error query returned no email error series.

The load-generator rollout at 04:29:29-30 is not the cause of this alert: checkout's PlaceOrder error rate was already non-zero at the 04:06:23 sample and reached ~0.5 spans/s well before 04:29, so the rollout postdates the failing signal (it is a change in the window for a different reason - a ReplicaSet rollout of the load generator).

Capture the POST /get-quote request body and the handler's rejection reason inside the shipping service (or review its source for the validation/decoding path that runs before the 'Requesting quote' log line), since the 400 is produced before the quote call and is currently invisible in logs and span tags.

Record an HTTP status code and error status on shipping's /get-quote server span (and alert on the '/get-quote' minus 'POST quote' span-rate gap) so this rejection appears as its own signal instead of only as missing downstream quote spans.

gaps: No pre-incident baseline: the query of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout"} over 01:00-04:05 (view b0616bf4-d6cd-4b7d-86f6-b20064c40e17-t1:2fe7223b-1d60-455b-bd76-1befffb4463d) returned no data, and the checkout error series starts at 04:05:23, so whether checkout errors were zero earlier is unknown.

The trigger of shipping's rejection is unobserved: the failing /get-quote spans carry no status tag, shipping logged no error/400 line in the slices read, no payloads or response bodies are available, and the query for shipping spans tagged http.status_code="400" (view 032a2826-5f42-42cb-a95e-b58a356570d9-t0:825ca554-7b82-467f-95b9-bf12aff16223) returned no data, which shows only that the query matched nothing.

Email container logs could not be inspected: fetch_pod_logs for email-59f69bc6cf-7wqqk over 04:00-04:45 (view 1da1fdfa-9137-4f5e-834f-19ab780febfe-t0:b7f4c5de-0bb2-4344-b971-20ba03a52e3b) returned no data (0 bytes read), so email's own view is unknown.

Trace coverage stops near 04:10 (Jaeger data_as_of up to about 04:10:13) and a checkout error-trace search for 04:35-04:40 (view 9bf79d59-95fc-4ce0-8b7f-a2db320e49ff-t1:964903c3-d311-4dc6-9760-95f072c60d59) returned no data; post-04:10 failures are visible only through span metrics, and the sampled trace searches flag that more may exist.

Kubernetes state metrics were unavailable: get_metric_names for kube_* (view 07ddf44c-8f98-458c-a116-1e82c79ca5a7-t0:b54225a6-6446-4b74-a36f-d8dc33d7ba06) and the kube_pod_container_info range query (view 288a6d04-4553-4816-86de-962f6ac7b9e7-t0:43935810-e05f-4740-a252-72e4d729d8ba) both returned no data, and the change_history integration is not available, so no image-digest or configuration change check for shipping/checkout before 04:05 could be made.
Flag values were read from ConfigMap flagd-config; runtime overrides applied through flagd (for example via flagd-ui) are not readable in this Run and could not be verified.

The frontend-proxy 'ingress' error series stays at 22-29 spans/s across the whole window, far above the checkout-related 'router frontend egress' errors (0.2-0.4/s); its source was not identified and no evidence ties it to this alert.

No metric series for ERROR on shipping, email, quote, cart, currency or product-catalog exists in this dataset; their absence means those services' error status is unknown from metrics, not proven zero, and their health was assessed only from the traces and logs that were read.
next_steps: Review the shipping service's /get-quote handler for validation/decoding branches that can return HTTP 400 before the 'Requesting quote' log line, and correlate them with the failing trace timestamps.
Temporarily log payload summaries (item count, currency, address presence) at shipping's /get-quote entry to identify what distinguishes the rejected ~26% of calls.
Add an HTTP status/error tag to shipping's /get-quote span and an alert on the '/get-quote' vs 'POST quote' span-rate gap so this failure mode becomes directly observable.
Verify runtime flagd values and any recent configuration change to the shipping or checkout workloads via a change-history source, which is not integrated in this Run.
